label: NexusPHP
description: NexusPHP private tracker (1.9 and later, with the API enabled). Stats come from /api/v1/profile with a personal access token. Older installs, or sites with the API switched off, report nothing — no profile scraping without staff approval.
notes:
UNTESTED AGAINST A LIVE SITE — written from NexusPHP's own source (github.com/xiaomlove/nexusphp, branch php8, 2026-09-25): routes/api.php, app/Http/Resources/UserResource.php, app/Repositories/UserRepository.php, include/globalfunctions.php. Confirm with tools/apiprobe on the first 1.9+ site someone can reach, and correct the field map here rather than in Go.

Endpoint: GET /api/v1/profile (Sanctum bearer token; the token needs the user:view permission). include_fields[user]=seeding_leeching_data adds seeding/leeching counts and sizes, computed from the peers table — the only source of seeding and seed size in the API.

Envelope: {ret, msg, data, time, rid}; ret 0 = success. The UserResource is wrapped by Laravel's JsonResource, so the user object is at data.data — the official Python client reads profile.data.data.username, which confirms it.

Two bonus currencies, both returned and kept apart on purpose: 'bonus' (the seedbonus column, 魔力值 — spendable, Yata's bonus_points) and 'seed_points' (做种积分 — accumulated, never spent). The stock NexusPHP class ladder promotes on seed_points, so mapping it to bonus_points would compare a spendable balance against a promotion threshold and read anyone who shops as under-qualified. seeding_points is its own field; PT-depiler drafts express the requirement as a min_counts row on it.

Ratio is computed from the raw byte counts (ratio_from_bytes) rather than read from share_ratio, which get_ratio formats for display. class_text is the site's class name in the request's locale — ladders are matched on it, so a def whose group names are in another language than the site answers in will not find the user's rank. Rate limit: 60 requests a minute per user (RouteServiceProvider), far above Yata's refresh rate.

api.api_key_hint: Control panel → Access Token → create one with the user:view permission (shown once)
